summary.text: SØRENGA 5 NÆRING AS (914 741 246), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2014-12-10; address c/o Malling & Co Forvaltning ASS, Dronning Mauds gate 15, 0250 OSLO, Norge.
